Reor.aanization of Consultative Committee. -
Committee created under Sec. 1 of Executive Order No. 292, s.
The Consultative
reconstituted with the following membership:
The Executive Secretary;
The Secretary, DILGI Chairman, Napolcom;
One (1) member of the Senate to be designated by the Senate President;
One (1) member of the House of Representative to be designated by the
Speaker of the House;
Such other members as the President, in his discretion, may designate.

The Executive Secretary shall chair the Committee.
Discretion of the President to Immediatel Issue A ointments in
~ertain Cas~. In urgent cases, or when so dictated by the exigency of the service, the
President may issue such appointment as may be necessary without the prior evaluation
by, or consultation with, the Consultative Committee; Provided, however, that
immediately after the issuance of the appointment the Consultative Committee shall be
informed thereof accordingly. Provided, further, that no provision in this Executive Order
shall be constrained as limiting, amending, or otherwise altering the authority of the
~resident under provisions of existing law with respect to the appointment of Philippine
National Police officials.
